results.hypothesis: To test whether increasing the temporal resolution of input measurements from hourly to 15-minute intervals improves forecasting accuracy by at least 5% as measured by MAE when using a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) model for short-horizon electricity demand forecasting (1-hour to 6-hour ahead).
results.author: coder-agent
results.baseline: The MAE achieved by the TFT model using hourly resolution input data
results.success_criteria: If the MAE of the model using 15-minute resolution data is at least 5% lower than the MAE of the model using hourly resolution data, the hypothesis is supported. If the improvement is less than 5% or negative, the hypothesis is refuted.
